summary.headline: Anthropic signs Korea safety pact; G7 hosts AI lab chiefs
summary.body: A calmer, slightly brighter day. Anthropic opened a Seoul office and signed an agreement with Korea's science ministry covering Korean-language safety evaluations and cyber-threat sharing. Better safety testing strengthens Alignment & Control, which lifts Protector God and Gatekeeper and pushes Conquerors down. At the G7 summit in Evian, leaders met Altman, Amodei and Hassabis and agreed principles to protect minors from harmful AI content, a modest boost to Global Coordination, though data-center sustainability goals were weakened over US objections. Separately, more than 300 security leaders asked the US to reverse its ban on Claude Fable 5. Horizon Balance rose to +1.63.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.2, Self-Destruction -0.1 and Benevolent Dictator +0.1. The Anthropic-Korea MOU (Gatekeeper +0.11) and the G7 session (Gatekeeper +0.10, Self-Destruction -0.07) drove the moves.

events.title: Security researchers sign open letter against US ban on Claude Fable 5
events.summary: 300+ cybersecurity leaders signed an open letter demanding the export ban be reversed, after researcher Katie Moussouris said the trigger was a simple 'fix this code' prompt rather than a true jailbreak; Amodei met administration officials without resolution.
events.reason: Government holding a frontier model offline shows state leverage over labs (power concentration in the state); contested by experts.

events.title: Anthropic opens Seoul office, signs AI-safety MOU with Korea's science ministry
events.summary: Anthropic's Seoul office opened with Naver, Samsung SDS and LG CNS deals; an MOU with Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT covers Korean-language safety evaluations with the Korea AI Safety Institute and cyber-threat sharing.

events.title: G7 Evian summit hosts AI lab CEOs; agrees minors' online protections
events.summary: G7 leaders held an AI session with Altman, Amodei and Hassabis and agreed principles to protect minors from harmful AI content, but weakened data-center sustainability goals over US objections.
events.reason: Soft multilateral statement; diluted by US resistance.
